_doc: D3-01 P5 heist casts, extended in D-115 to the four pre-P5 heists (ENV D). heist -> role -> [character ids]; each id's scene is res://world/characters/<id>/<id>.tscn (characters.json lists them). P5 roles are generic names; the D-115 heists (glasshouse, night_deposit, dockside_burn, shadow_ledger) are keyed by the spawn tags in the design doc's roster table (docs/design/heists/<heist>.md, '### ... roster (spawn data)'), so ENV A's NpcVisualTweak.heist_tag_characters can mirror them 1:1; the camera operator is security_operator (CAMERA_OPERATOR spawn) and 'police' is the director's police roster. Reused ids are D1/D2 characters cast again (D-063 reserved the tellers, guests and waitress for P5). Faction-variant ids (<id>_frd|_sentinel|_zero) are picked per difficulty by EnemyDef.params.visual_variant (characters.md v1.6), so only the base ids are listed. tag_map.<heist> (GN-D1) is the spawn tag -> [ids] map ENV A mirrors 1:1 into NpcVisualTweak.heist_tag_characters for heists whose roles above are generic (gallery_night); its ids come from that heist's roles. pager_roles lists the P5 pager roles only. Hand-maintained by ENV D; checked by game/tests/d/test_p5_cast.gd.

notes.gallery_night: Halberd Gallery Security is the gallery's in-house guard (bottle-green blazer, Halberd crest), not Halden or Northgate. The curator is the keycard carrier and the one pale suit at the gala. GN-D1 polish: nine distinct patron looks (five women, four men, evening wear in dark or jewel tones) for up to nine live patrons; two attendant looks (man in the waistcoat, woman in the jacket); two waitstaff (npc_penthouse_staff the waitress, gallery_waiter in the wine waistcoat); the conservator has his own work-wear look (gallery_conservator: knit vest, canvas apron, loupe) instead of reusing gallery_attendant_b. Insurance inspectors wear the Halberd blazer (QC-58d); the Vaultline couriers are armored_car_crew/_b.
notes.ostrander_federal: Ostrander Federal (D-075). Tellers keep the D2-02 bank livery and the new day manager (keycard carrier) matches it; the gallery-level loan/accounts officers (D-075) wear grey suits with the bank's red lanyard and ID badge. Guards are Halden Security: the day officers (peaked cap) and the bare-headed night guard (camera operator). civilian_customer_b is the elderly customer; bank_customer_b is the parent with a backpack.
notes.rolling_thunder: The crew works for Vaultline Armored Transport (original). The escort is the police/TAC roster plus its frd/sentinel/zero reskins by difficulty; no new escort model.
notes.afterhours: Staff wear black and the Velvet's violet; patrons are mixed club wear. club_bouncer_b's Hip/Socket is on a belt radio; club_bouncer's is the default hip seat (radio under the bomber is not modelled).
notes.glasshouse: Golden Hour (D-115). Guards and the operator are Halden. Greta Vossberg (owner/manager, rare nervous_manager) is civilian_manager_vossberg; the two associates are told apart (civilian_sales at the counter, civilian_sales_b on the floor); the upstairs admin clerk wears civilian_clerk office wear, not the shop-floor dress. Customers add the Ostrander bank_customer looks for variety. Guard tags and the operator are not in the roster table: they come from the guard_post variant table and the CameraOperatorSeat spawn.
notes.night_deposit: Nightfall Depository (D-115). Halden on the floor (D-116: four faces security_officer a-d, one pool for hall, basement and rovers); the seated operator is the bare-headed Halden night guard (npc_bank_guard). The night manager (code carrier) is npc_bank_night_manager (bank livery, D2-02). The armored_car_early guards are the Vaultline crew (guard_armored_car, from the rare-event table, not the roster).
notes.dockside_burn: Dockside Burn (D-115). Co-op cartel gunmen on every cartel post (EnemyDef enemy.cartel_gunman visual_alternates), one pool of twelve faces cartel_gunman a-l (D-115 DB cast: up to 12 posted at Cataclysm, no twins; three women, slung long gun on six); night-shift workers are the dock crew (civ_worker: dock_worker, dock_worker_b and dock_worker_c, one pool of three yard-hand faces, D-115 DB cast; civ_worker_packer, DB-C2: the packing-table worker, dock_packer), never bank staff. Police are the director roster plus faction reskins.
notes.shadow_ledger: Shadow Ledger (D-115). Every guard and the operator are Northgate Executive Protection, never Halden: one pool of six faces (npc_northgate_guard a-f, D-116) for the reception, rover, stair, roof and operator tags, so Lethal's 5 guards + the operator are never twins. Cleaners wear the Calder tabard on both floors, one pool of three faces: npc_cleaner_sl (man, buzz cut), npc_cleaner_sl_b (D-SL-2: woman, late 50s, grey bun), npc_cleaner_sl_c (D-116: young man, glasses). Helena Moor is npc_helena_moor, Victor Kessler npc_kessler (robe, reading in the bedside armchair: sit_chair_read).
